name: Distinguish feelings from requested actions
short_description: Distinguish feelings from requested actions once under stated everyday conditions without assistance.
self_assessment: I can distinguish feelings from requested actions in one repeatable attempt without help.
description: Distinguish feelings from requested actions means carrying out this capability under ordinary, stated conditions without another person completing any part. Practice focuses on the observable result, the threshold in the self-assessment, and repeatability across more than one occasion. The capability includes selecting an appropriate approach, completing the action, and checking the outcome. It excludes brand-specific steps, credentials, unrelated habits, and one-off achievements.
examples: Distinguish feelings from requested actions in a fresh real-life scenario.
